style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and variant screens, light summer sky-blue #DDEDF7 for hero and trust screens, warm light-neutral #F7F6F2 for infographic and macro screens, styled scene on a grey woven-fabric wall #8A8578 above a warm wood plank floor #B98A5A
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color #2E6DA8
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; scene shots use soft natural window light at 5500K; no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh summer kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light summer sky-blue #DDEDF7, charcoal text #33383D and one ocean-blue accent #2E6DA8, with warm light-neutral #F7F6F2 reserved as the infographic and macro backdrop tone; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows, scene shots use soft natural window light at 5500K; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end garment photography with minimal infographic elements; garment always presented flat-laid, on a plain hanger, or ghost-mannequin style with stable scale, never on a recognizable child model; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle; garment always shown flat-laid, on a plain hanger, or ghost-mannequin style at a stable scale, never on a recognizable child model; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte white studio sweep, light warm wood plank floor, matte neutral board for macro detail shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; warm light-neutral #F7F6F2 stays in use as the infographic and macro backdrop tone
